versions.short: The bill would require the Transportation Security Administration to develop guidelines within one year of enactment to improve access to the Transportation Worker Identification Credential program. The guidelines would aim to help people recently released from incarceration get into the program, help incarcerated people prepare applications in advance, and help individuals appeal or seek waivers of preliminary decisions that they are ineligible for the credential. After developing the guidelines, the agency would brief the House Homeland Security Committee and the Senate Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee on how the provisions are being carried out.
